{{Quote|If you surrender now, your soldiers will have died in vain. Is that what you want? What about the man inside that base waiting to be rescued? You'd abandon him? This is a moment of truth, Sergeant. Do you give up and let evil win, or stand up and fight?|The Knight inspires Nidaljo to fight|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[special tactical unit]] and a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] '''raided''' the [[Black Sun Headquarters|headquarters]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to rescue the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]]. Tarnis, the creator of the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], had been [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapped]] by Black Sun and taken to the [[Black Sun territory|gang's territory]], and the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] on an [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|assignment]] on Coruscant&mdash; was sent to rescue the scientist. With the aid of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] and the special tactical unit, the Knight and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] successfully invaded the gang's headquarters, but instead of finding Tarnis, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discovered that Tarnis was in fact a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Together, the CSF and the Jedi defeated the Black Sun leader [[Salarr]], and put a major dent in the syndicate's operations, and the Knight returned to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] determined to hunt down the [[Desolator crisis|traitorous]] Tarnis.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Go to these coordinates. Talk to Sergeant Nidaljo. He can help you rescue Doctor Tarnis and get those copied data files.|Agent Galen|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]&mdash;who was posing as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working on the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]&mdash;felt that his [[Desolator crisis|undercover mission]] was threatened<ref name="The Rescue" /> by the [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|arrival]] of four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]: the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Orgus Din]], Kiwiiks' [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], and Din's recently [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Knighted]] [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]].<ref name="Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref> Arranging<ref name="The Rescue" /> for the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] crime syndicate to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|steal]] the Planet Prison's design files,<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> Tarnis then staged his own [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] with the help of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate<ref name="Kidnapped" /> in exchange for Imperial weapons and technology.<ref name="The Rescue" /> After capturing the kidnappers' leader, a man named [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]], following a [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|standoff]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], Carsen and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] learned that the firefight had been a distraction while Tarnis was whisked away to [[Black Sun territory]]. The two Jedi alerted [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, of the developments before returning to the Senate Building,<ref name="Kidnapped" /> and Galen immediately reached out to his contacts in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF).<ref name="The Rescue" />

[[File:CSFspecialtacunit.png|thumb|left|200px|The special tactical unit]]
At Galen's request, the CSF's [[special tactical unit]] diverted from their assignment of fighting Black Sun to gather information on the [[Black Sun Headquarters|syndicate's headquarters]] and set up a perimeter around the building. However, Tarnis had never actually made it to Black Sun territory, as he had traveled to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of his allies in the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]] instead.<ref name="The Rescue" /> Back at the Senate Building, the two Jedi updated their Masters and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on the situation.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> While the design files had been [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recovered]] earlier by the Knight,<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Galen's analysts had determined that the files had actually contained information on the entire [[Republic superweapon initiative]] and had been copied by Black Sun, putting the Republic's weapons projects at risk. As a result, Galen and the Jedi Masters decided to depart Coruscant in order to secure each of the three off-world weapons facilities, and Galen left all of his available resources at the Jedi Knight's disposal. Galen also notified the Knight of the location of the special tactical unit and told the Jedi to make contact with the unit's leader, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]], as he would be able to help retrieve both the copied data files and Doctor Tarnis.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|This is your fault. We never should've trusted a Sith!.''"<br />"''If a Jedi has come for you, Salarr, it wasn't my doing.|Salarr and Tarnis|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
While Carsen remained behind at the Senate Building, the Knight departed with an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] companion, [[T7-O1]], or "Teeseven," and took an an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] to Black Sun territory. While the duo were fighting their way to Nidaljo's location in the [[Lower Gangland]] region, the special tactical unit was suddenly attacked by heavily armed Black Sun members, who overwhelmed the [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and drove them into a nearby building, [[Death/Legends|killing]] six of the unit's members in the process. Nidaljo's men set up a hasty barricade in an attempt to hold off the criminals, and the Knight's timely arrival saw the Jedi cut down the Black Sun attackers and grant the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] a reprieve. Speaking with the Sergeant, the Knight learned what had happened, and the death of a seventh [[Officer/Legends|officer]]&mdash;a man named [[Jorin]]&mdash;during their conversation only served to dampen Nidaljo's spirits further.<ref name="The Rescue" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:Black_Sun_headshot.png|thumb|right|190px|Nidaljo's men eliminate a Black Sun criminal before he shoots the Knight.]]
However, the Jedi was able to inspire the downtrodden CSF officers to continue their mission, and Nidaljo's men soon rallied to the Knight's call and prepared for an assault. While Nidaljo's men readied themselves for the attack, the Jedi and Teeseven took out the base's main security network and defenders near the front entrance, and both groups then launched assaults on the headquarters from opposite directions. When the Knight and Teeseven finally reached the command center, they found the leader of Black Sun&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Salarr]]&mdash;speaking with a hooded Tarnis via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]]. Listening to Tarnis, the Jedi learned that the scientist was in fact a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], and that he had traded weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to Black Sun in return for them faking his kidnapping. Salarr was furious with Tarnis for betraying him, as he thought that the Sith had set him up, but Tarnis brushed aside the criminal's anger and warned the Jedi that Coruscant was already doomed. When Tarnis ordered Salarr to kill the Knight and ended the transmission, one of Salarr's men tried to shoot the Jedi in the back. However, Sergeant Nidaljo and two of his men arrived at that moment and dispatched the criminal before he could pull the trigger. The Knight greeted Nidaljo and ordered Salarr to surrender, but the gang leader attacked regardless. With the advantage of numbers, Nidaljo and the Jedi were able to defeat Salarr and the other criminals without further loss of life.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Can't believe it! We just took down Salarr. Black Sun won't forget that anytime soon. We lost some good soldiers, but this victory gives their deaths meaning.|Sergeant Nidaljo|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
Nidaljo and his men celebrated briefly before the Knight was contacted by Carsen via Salarr's holoterminal. She had intercepted Salarr's holocall to Tarnis, and was astonished to learn that the doctor was a Sith. Carsen also had worse news&mdash;the Planet Prison that was in the lab was a fake, and Tarnis had stolen the real one. The Jedi ordered Carsen to trace the holocall, and the Knight and Teeseven returned to the Senate Building. Despite their victory, Nidaljo knew that his men could not hold the base successfully, and the unit retreated from the area.<ref name="The Rescue" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You men will do everything you can to assist me. We're going to the base&mdash;now.''"<br />"''We're going to the base now. On your feet, men. Ration your medical supplies and give some to the Jedi.|The Knight mind-tricks Nidaljo|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
The raid on the Black Sun headquarters was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears in the Jedi Knight class story mission "Kidnapped!," in which the player ventures into Black Sun territory to rescue the kidnapped Doctor Tarnis. The quest features several points at which alignment choices can affect the outcome, but this article assumes that the Knight chooses the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] options as a light side character. The first turning point is when Nidaljo is about to give up hope, and the player can choose how to encourage him. For [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points, the player can [[Mind trick/Legends|Force Persuade]] the Sergeant to help, or they can choose to insult the officer and leave without him for no alignment points and no aid in the battle with Salarr. The light side option is to inspire Nidaljo to help through words, which will also results in Nidaljo coming to aid the player against Salarr. If Nidaljo is present at the fight, the player can gain additional dark side points by ordering the CSF officers to attack Salarr without asking for his surrender.<ref name="The Rescue" />
